title: The tennis tournament that led to the scholarship
summary: He beat Talladega and 'Bama State in a tournament, lost to Wilberforce, and was then called to 'Bama State on a tennis scholarship.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Okay. Good. Okay. Now, all of these things are coming together from many different areas, your interest in sports and all of this, the kind of capabilities you develop on a number of instruments, and your early theoretical training, and then your ability, as you said before, to sort of

I went to, I was playing tennis in a tournament. 'Bama State was there. Talladega was there, and quite a few other schools. But, I had to play them in the tournament. I was representing Tuggle Institute. And, I eliminated Talladega first. I eliminated 'Bama State. Oh yeah, Wilberforce University out of Ohio.
Then, I had to play Wilberforce to get to play for the champion. Well, Wilberforce eliminated me. That's as far as I got in that.
Then, the next thing I knew was I had gotten a call from 'Bama State for a scholarship to come there on account of tennis, not knowing anything about the music. They wanted me down there for that.
And so, I got down to 'Bama State on tennis.
